legalName: Connecticut request for physical destruction of already-erased records under C.G.S. Sec. 54-142a(g)(1)
routeSelectionNote: The exact route is fixed as obligation:track-only:CT:ct-destruction-request. The guide selects that agency route and presents no alternate instrument for the participant to elect.

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Case court, location, docket number, and final-disposition date
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Case court, location, docket number, and final-disposition date
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no participant case record is held
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the court location, docket number, and final-disposition date exactly as the case record states them; confirm it with the Superior Court clerk that handled the case

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Clerk-confirmed request form, method, destination, and fee
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Clerk-confirmed request form, method, destination, and fee
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the committed review does not establish a statewide request format or fee
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the exact way that clerk wants the request made, where it goes, required attachments, and any fee; confirm it with the Superior Court clerk's office holding the erased records

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Confirmation that the records were already erased under Section 54-142a
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Confirmation that the records were already erased under Section 54-142a
requiredBeforeFiling.why: existing erasure is a route precondition the platform cannot assume
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: written or clerk-confirmed evidence that the record has already been erased; confirm it with the Superior Court clerk holding the record

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date the three-year destruction bar expires
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date the three-year destruction bar expires
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform does not hold the final-disposition date
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: three years after the final-disposition date, calculated only after that date is confirmed; confirm it with the case record and the clerk

maps.composedFrom: the committed Connecticut memo, guidance record, exact census route, and counsel manifest, each hashed into source-receipt.json at build time
